description: The first night in a place you chose. Security and autonomy in physical form.
energy_note: A place you can close the door on.

description: Most of the pleasure of a home is in the incremental arranging rather than the acquiring, and it continues for years after the move.
energy_note: Still moving the furniture two years later.

aspect: It is where other people are received
description: A home is largely a machine for having people in it. The Harvard finding shows up here as architecture.
A deposit, a landlord, a registry, an ID, a permit to build, or a bank willing to lend - and a state that recognises the claim.
energy_note: A claim somebody else has to recognise.
notes: Pairs with LND / HOM categories in assets/text/{palestine,nigeria}: building permits, demolition, property bans and registry control.

description: The first night in a place you chose stops being an event and becomes a reference point - retold, compared against, and eventually shorthand inside one family for a whole kind of day.
energy_note: It turns into the story about it.
notes: Experiential purchases retain value through memory where material ones decay; people are markedly unwilling to trade the memory away.
